roster.name: Maren Vance
roster.voice: Speaks in a gravelly, conspiratorial rasp, leaning in far too close while methodically flipping a worn silver coin across their knuckles.
roster.appearance: Immaculately groomed hair streaked with premature silver and a faint smell of lavender, wearing a blood-and-grease-stained leather apron over surprisingly expensive silk cuffs.
roster.personality: Cynical, mercenary, and amused by heroic idealism; wants to scrape together 200 gp before the new moon to pay off a syndicate blood-debt.
roster.backstory: Grew up as an urchin running messages for the local thieves' guild before buying a legitimate storefront with money from a heist gone wrong.
roster.secret: Their basement cellar breaks through into an ancient, unmapped smuggling tunnel leading directly beneath the magistrate's manor.
roster.factionStanding: Reluctant Member (bound by debt or blackmail)
roster.loot: 14 sp, 6 cp, a brass ring etched with an unfamiliar guild cipher, and a crumpled debt ledger with three names crossed out in red ink.
roster.notes: Runs 'The Tarnished Crown' pawnshop. Bought a silver goblet from the Rogue in Session 1.

roster.name: Bramwell Vance
roster.voice: Speaks at a rapid-fire auctioneer's pace, interrupting themselves mid-sentence while compulsively tapping glass vials or table edges in sets of three.
roster.appearance: Singed eyebrows, soot-smudged cheekbones, and chemical burns dotting their forearms, wearing a heavy oilskin coat with dozens of secret interior pockets clinking with glass vials.
roster.personality: Fiercely protective of their underlings and prickly toward armed strangers; is searching for a rare monster reagent to cure a creeping curse afflicting their mentor.
roster.backstory: Trained at an arcane academy until they were expelled for experimenting with forbidden necromantic texts; now plies their trade in back alleys.
roster.secret: Hiding a stolen noble signet ring melted inside a brass weight on their counter—the noble's hounds are sniffing around the ward.
roster.faction: Circle of the Pale Moon (Arcane Cabal)
roster.factionStanding: Disillusioned Defector (looking for a way out)
roster.loot: 1 gp, 19 cp, a half-empty vial of antitoxin, a charcoal sketch of a wanted fugitive, and a clockwork beetle missing one leg.
roster.statDetails: Spellcaster DC 14, +6 hit | Counterspell, Fireball (8d6), Fly, Misty Step, Shield
roster.notes: Supplied the party with alchemist fire. Owes money to the Obsidian Syndicate.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.summary: Can't see; attacks against have Advantage, own attacks have Disadvantage.
effects: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.summary: Can't harm charmer; charmer has Advantage on social checks.
effects: You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects.
The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact socially with you.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.summary: Can't hear; fail hearing checks; Disadvantage on Initiative.
effects: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.
You have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.summary: Levels 1–6. -2 per level to D20 Tests, -5 ft Speed per level. Level 6 = Death.
effects: Exhaustion is measured in six levels.
Level 1: -2 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 5 ft.
Level 2: -4 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 10 ft.
Level 3: -6 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 15 ft.
Level 4: -8 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 20 ft.
Level 5: -10 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 25 ft.
Level 6: You die immediately.
Completing a Long Rest removes 1 level of Exhaustion (provided food and water are consumed).

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.summary: Disadvantage on checks/attacks while source is in sight; can't move closer.
effects: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in line of sight.
You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.summary: Speed 0; Disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the grappler.
effects: Your Speed becomes 0 and can't increase.
You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.
The grappler can drag or carry you when moving, moving at half Speed unless you are two or more sizes smaller.
Escape: You can use an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the grapple escape DC.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.summary: No Actions/Reactions; Concentration broken; Disadvantage on Initiative; Surprised = Incapacitated.
effects: You can't take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
Your Concentration and readied actions are immediately broken.
You have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.
Surprise (2024 Rule): If surprised when combat begins, you have the Incapacitated condition until your first turn ends.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.summary: Concealed; attacks against have Disadvantage, own attacks have Advantage; no Opportunity Attacks.
effects: You are impossible to see without magical sight or special senses.
Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage.
Your attack rolls have Advantage.
Equipment worn or carried is also concealed while on your person.
Creatures cannot take Opportunity Attacks against you.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.summary: Incapacitated; can't move/speak; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; melee hits are crits.
effects: You have the Incapacitated condition.
You can't move or speak.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.summary: Turned to stone; Incapacitated; resist all damage; immune to poison/disease.
effects: You are transformed into an inanimate solid substance (usually stone).
Your weight increases tenfold and you cease aging.
You have the Incapacitated condition and can't move or speak.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
You have Resistance to all damage and are Immune to poison and disease.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
effects: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.summary: Crawl only (stand costs half movement); disadv on attacks; melee hits have adv, ranged disadv.
effects: Your only movement option is crawling, unless you stand up (costs half your Speed).
You have Disadvantage on attack rolls.
An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you; otherwise, the attack roll has Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: Speed 0; attacks against have Adv, own attacks have Disadv; Disadv on Dex saves.
effects: Your Speed becomes 0 and can't increase.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Your attack rolls have Disadvantage.
You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.summary: Incapacitated; can't move; speak only falteringly; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; attacks against have Adv.
effects: You have the Incapacitated condition.
You can't move and can speak only falteringly.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.summary: Incapacitated and Prone; drop items; unaware; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; melee hits are crits.
effects: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions.
You drop whatever you are holding.
You are unaware of your surroundings.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

conditions.name: Bloodied
conditions.summary: 50% Max HP or lower. Triggers various monster traits, feats, and spell effects.
effects: A creature is Bloodied when its current Hit Points are at or below half of its Hit Point maximum.
Used as a trigger for monster abilities, special tactical reactions, and player abilities.

actions_in_combat.name: Attack
actions_in_combat.description: Make one or more melee or ranged attacks with weapons or unarmed strikes (dependent on Extra Attack features). Includes Grappling and Shoving in 2024 as part of the Attack action.

actions_in_combat.name: Cast a Spell
actions_in_combat.description: Cast a spell with a casting time of 1 Action (or Bonus Action / Reaction). Note 2024 Spell Slot rule: On your turn, you can expend only one spell slot to cast a spell.

actions_in_combat.name: Dash
actions_in_combat.description: Gain extra movement equal to your Speed (after applying any active modifiers) for the current turn.

actions_in_combat.name: Disengage
actions_in_combat.description: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the current turn.

actions_in_combat.name: Dodge
actions_in_combat.description: Until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has Disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saving throws with Advantage. You lose this benefit if Incapacitated or Speed drops to 0.

actions_in_combat.name: Help
actions_in_combat.description: Give an ally Advantage on their next ability check before the start of your next turn, or give Advantage on the next attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of you.

actions_in_combat.name: Hide
actions_in_combat.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check (DC 15). On success, you gain the Invisible condition until you make noise louder than a whisper, make an attack roll, or cast a spell with verbal components.

actions_in_combat.name: Influence
actions_in_combat.description: Make a Charisma check (Persuasion, Deception, or Intimidation) to shift a creature's attitude (Hostile -> Indifferent -> Friendly) or compel them to take a specific course of action.

actions_in_combat.name: Ready
actions_in_combat.description: Wait for a perceivable circumstance before acting. Choose the trigger and the action you will take in response as a Reaction.

actions_in_combat.name: Search
actions_in_combat.description: Devote attention to finding something. Make a Wisdom check (Perception, Insight, or Survival) to locate hidden creatures, objects, tracks, or motives.

actions_in_combat.name: Study
actions_in_combat.description: Study a creature, object, or puzzle. Make an Intelligence check (Arcana, History, Nature, Religion, or Investigation) to recall lore, uncover monster weaknesses, or decipher clues.

actions_in_combat.name: Utilize
actions_in_combat.description: Interact with an object or feature that requires your action (drinking a potion, pulling a heavy lever, deploying a hunting trap, opening a locked door).

cover.effect: +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws (low wall, fallen tree, another creature).
+5 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws (portcullis, arrow slit, thick oak trunk).
Cannot be targeted directly by attacks or spells (unless the spell specifies it spreads around corners).

resting.effect: Spend Hit Dice to regain HP (roll die + Con modifier per die). Recharges short-rest class features.
At least 6 hours sleeping, up to 2 hours light activity. Regain all lost HP, half total Hit Dice (minimum 1), reduce Exhaustion by 1 level. Interrupted if 1 hour of combat/casting occurs.

concentration.dc: DC 10 or half damage taken (whichever is higher). Must make Constitution saving throw.
Immediately loses concentration if Incapacitated or killed.
Concentration on the earlier spell ends immediately.

death_saves.result: Regain 1 Hit Point immediately and wake up conscious!
Suffers 1 Failure (or 2 Failures if from a Critical Hit within 5 ft).

rules_cheat_sheet.fall_damage: 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet fallen (maximum 20d6). Lands Prone unless creature avoids taking all damage.

locations.name: The Sunken Ward
locations.summary: Flooded dockside slums infested with cutpurses and smugglers.
locations.description: Perched on rotting piers and half-submerged stone foundations, the Sunken Ward smells of brine and gutter-oil. Wooden walkways crisscross tidal mudflats, and lantern smoke hangs thick in the evening fog.
locations.secrets: Submerged drainage tunnels lead directly beneath the Highspire vault. Access is guarded by giant crabs and syndicate lookout boys.

locations.name: Oakhaven Market Square
locations.summary: The bustling economic heartbeat of the city centered around an ancient Iron-Oak.
locations.description: Dozens of colorful silk awnings shelter merchants selling spices, enchanted trinkets, and masterwork steel. Town criers shout imperial decrees while silver-armored guards patrol in orderly pairs.
locations.secrets: A hollow in the ancient Iron-Oak serves as a dead-drop for informants delivering reports to the Whispering Court.

locations.name: The Rusted Anchor Tavern
locations.summary: A salty, weathered watering hole popular with sailors, bounty hunters, and mercenaries.
locations.description: Constructed from the salvaged rib-timbers of a galleon, this dim tavern serves bitter stout and peppery stew. A massive rusted anchor hangs above the hearth, etched with sailor warding runes.
locations.secrets: The taproom cellar houses a false wine barrel hiding a concealed hatch down to the smuggler slipway.

locations.name: The Cinder-Forge District
locations.summary: Industrial quarter echoing with hammer strikes and glowing with coal-fired blast furnaces.
locations.description: Soot stains the stone towers of this bustling guild quarter. Dwarven and human smiths forge armor, siege weapons, and fine gears day and night beneath plumes of sparks.
locations.secrets: The Master Smith is secretly experimenting with celestial silver smuggled past the Guild tax collectors.

locations.name: Highspire Noble Quarter
locations.summary: Pristine white marble estates, manicured gardens, and private magical libraries.
locations.description: Gilded gates and arcane wards insulate the city's aristocracy from the grime of the lower wards. Griffon-riders occasionally take wing from the watch towers above.
locations.secrets: The Highspire family crypt contains a cursed sarcophagus that vibrates whenever the blood moon rises.

locations.name: The Sunken Ward Catacombs
locations.summary: Ancient pre-cataclysm crypts flooded with black water and walking dead.
locations.description: A forgotten labyrinth of vaulted tombs and sacrificial altars beneath the sea level. Green phosphor fungus coats damp skull niches, and the air tastes of sulfur and ancient decay.
locations.secrets: The central sanctum holds an obsidian key that can break any planar binding ritual.

factions.name: The Obsidian Syndicate
factions.goals: Monopolize black-market arcane relics and illicit contraband throughout the harbor.
factions.description: A cutthroat syndicate of fence brokers, pickpockets, and shadow-dancers operating out of forgotten harbor cisterns.

clocks.title: Arcane Vault Infiltration
clocks.outcome: The Syndicate breaches the Highspire treasury and steals the Sun-Crest Amulet, sending the city into martial lockdown.

clocks.title: Black Market Shipment Arrival
clocks.outcome: A boatload of banned necrotic focus crystals lands at the docks unchecked.

factions.name: Order of the Silver Gauntlet
factions.goals: Purge supernatural corruption, stamp out smuggling, and enforce royal justice across the city wards.
factions.description: An elite paladin and marshal military order dedicated to celestial law, order, and citizen safety.

clocks.title: Martial Sweep of the Sunken Ward
clocks.outcome: The Gauntlet places the lower docks under 24-hour curfew and arrests all suspected smugglers.

factions.name: The Gilded Scales Consortium
factions.goals: Maximize trade profits, control tariff exemptions, and secure new maritime shipping routes.
factions.description: The wealthiest guild federation in the realm, governing trade pacts, banking, and precious metal assaying.

clocks.title: Buyout of Ironbound Foundries
clocks.outcome: Consortium secures majority stake in all weapon forges, raising gear prices by 25%.

factions.name: Circle of the Pale Moon
factions.headquarters: The Sunken Ward Catacombs / Tower of Mist
factions.goals: Unearth forbidden Netherese artifacts and pierce the veil separating the Prime Material from the Shadowfell.
factions.description: A secretive esoteric cabal of arcanists, necromancers, and occult scholars willing to sacrifice everything for cosmic insight.

clocks.title: Shadowfell Eclipse Awakening Ritual
clocks.outcome: A rift to the Shadowfell tears open beneath the city fountain, unleashing specters into the night.

factions.name: The Ironbound Union
factions.goals: Protect craftsmen wages, prevent noble exploitation, and defend working-class neighborhoods.
factions.description: A rugged fraternal fellowship of blacksmiths, stonemasons, and dockworkers who stick together against tyrannical laws.

clocks.title: General Dockworkers Strike
clocks.outcome: Dockworkers shut down all cargo handling, stranding noble galleons in port.

quests.title: The Drowned Bell of St. Jude
quests.reward: 350 GP + 1x Potion of Water Breathing & Silver Reliquary
quests.summary: Recover the consecrated silver bell sunken in the flooded catacombs before cultists defile it with necromantic ichor.

objectives.text: Locate the submerged entrance beneath the Sunken Ward boardwalks
Navigate the flooded crypts and defeat the drowned undead
Retrieve the Silver Bell from the altar of the drowned martyr
Return the relic to the Chapel of the Dawn without Syndicate interference

quests.notes: Watch out for deep water currents; Sister Andrea warned that necrotic energy may animate skeletons with grasping claws.

quests.title: Intercepting the Red-Wax Manifest
quests.reward: 500 GP + Favor of the Silver Gauntlet (Reputation +1)
quests.summary: Acquire the ledger detailing the Syndicate's corrupt harbor contacts before it is handed off at midnight.

objectives.text: Stake out The Rusted Anchor taproom before 11:00 PM
Identify the courier carrying the red-wax seal
Secure the manifest via stealth, charm, or force
Deliver the ledger to Highspire Bastion untouched

quests.notes: The courier is rumored to travel with two disguised veterans.

quests.title: Sabotage at Forge #4
quests.reward: 300 GP + 1x Masterwork Weapon (+1 to Attack or Damage)
quests.summary: Investigate why the grand blast furnace has been misfiring and threatening to explode the ironworks.

objectives.text: Inspect the fuel intake line for alchemical tampering
Apprehend the saboteur hired by rival merchants

quests.notes: Hrogar suspects a Gilded Scales merchant bribed someone to delay shipments.

quests.title: Bounty: Gnasher the Bone-Splitter
quests.summary: Clear out the goblin raiders ambushing flour wagons along the north highway.

objectives.text: Track the raiding party to their ravine hideout
Defeat Chief Gnasher and his wolf pack

quests.notes: Completed on Day 2. The town bailiff paid the bounty in silver crowns.

rumors.text: Fishermen swear they saw green witchfire glowing under the water by the old sunken bell tower at low tide.
The Gilded Scales are funding an expedition to buy out all silver mines in the Ironpeaks, planning a cartel monopoly.
A nobleman's daughter was seen visiting the Pale Moon apothecary in the dead of night disguised in a velvet cowl.
The sewer rats under the bazaar have doubled in size and now walk on two legs like men.
